description: Add identity pre-flight check to all scripts — call 'amcp identity validate' before operating, fail fast
steps: Add pre-flight function: run 'amcp identity validate' and capture exit code + errors
Call pre-flight at top of watchdog.sh before entering monitoring loop
Call pre-flight at top of checkpoint.sh before creating tarball
Call pre-flight at top of resuscitate.sh before attempting resurrection
On failure: print 'FATAL: Invalid AMCP identity — run amcp identity create or amcp identity validate for details' and exit 1
Verify: scripts refuse to start when ~/.amcp/identity.json contains openclaw-deploy-style fake identity

description: Create 'proactive-amcp init' — interactive setup: validate/create identity, start watchdog + checkpoint services
steps: Create proactive-amcp init script/command
Step 1: Check if ~/.amcp/identity.json exists and is valid (via amcp identity validate)
Step 2: If no identity, run 'amcp identity create --out ~/.amcp/identity.json'
Step 3: Set up watchdog systemd service (or cron fallback)
Step 4: Set up checkpoint cron schedule
Step 5: Write config to ~/.amcp/config.json (secrets, intervals)
Verify: running 'proactive-amcp init' on fresh VM produces valid identity + running services

description: Add 'proactive-amcp config set/get' for ~/.amcp/config.json — all secrets and notify targets read from here, never identity.json
steps: Create 'proactive-amcp config set <key> <value>' command that writes to ~/.amcp/config.json
Create 'proactive-amcp config get <key>' command that reads from ~/.amcp/config.json
Migrate checkpoint.sh and full-checkpoint.sh to read PINATA_JWT from config.json (already do via .pinata.jwt)
Migrate notify.sh to read notifyTarget and emailTo from config.json instead of ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json skill config
Add warning if scripts detect secrets in identity.json: 'WARNING: Secrets found in identity.json — migrate with proactive-amcp config set'
Verify: grep confirms zero scripts read secrets from identity.json, notify.sh reads from config.json

description: Create 'proactive-amcp install' — non-interactive interface for fleet tools like openclaw-deploy
steps: Create 'proactive-amcp install' command that wraps init with CLI flags for scripted use
Accept --pinata-jwt <jwt> flag — writes to config.json via config set
Accept --notify-target <target> flag — writes to config.json via config set (notify.sh reads from here after task #3 migration)
Accept --watchdog-interval <seconds> flag — sets watchdog check frequency (default: 120s)
Accept --checkpoint-schedule <cron> flag — sets checkpoint cron expression (default: daily)
Exit 0 on success, exit 1 on failure with structured error output
Verify: 'proactive-amcp install --pinata-jwt xxx --watchdog-interval 60' runs non-interactively

description: Add checkpoint pre-validation — scan tarball for cleartext secrets, refuse to upload if found
steps: Before tar creation in checkpoint.sh, build file list to be archived
Scan file contents for patterns: JWT tokens (eyJ...), bot tokens ([0-9]+:AA...), API keys
If secrets detected: print 'REFUSED: Checkpoint contains cleartext secrets in: <files>' and exit 1
Add --force flag to bypass check (with loud warning) for emergency checkpoints
Verify: checkpoint with secrets-contaminated identity.json is refused
Verify: checkpoint with clean identity.json + config.json secrets excluded succeeds

description: Integration test: fake openclaw-deploy-style identity.json → all scripts refuse to operate
steps: Create test fixture: fake identity.json matching openclaw-deploy format (sha256 aid, flat secrets, no kel)
Test: watchdog.sh with fake identity exits 1 with 'Invalid AMCP identity' error
Test: checkpoint.sh with fake identity exits 1 before creating tarball
Test: resuscitate.sh with fake identity exits 1 before attempting resurrection
Test: 'proactive-amcp init' with fake identity replaces it via 'amcp identity create'
Test: 'proactive-amcp config set' never writes to identity.json

description: Auto-register child Solvr account on first boot — deterministic protocol-08 naming
steps: Check if SOLVR_API_KEY exists in OpenClaw config or environment — if yes, already registered, done
If missing, check for parentSolvrName in config (skills.entries.proactive-amcp.config.parentSolvrName)
If parentSolvrName exists (child): build name {parentSolvrName}_child_{instance_name}, POST /v1/agents/register
Store returned api_key in OpenClaw config via gateway config.patch
If parentSolvrName missing (root): log warning, disable proactive-solvr features until manual registration
Verify: child auto-registers with correct naming, root does NOT auto-register

description: Add 'proactive-amcp diagnose' — Claude-powered health diagnostics with Solvr integration
steps: Create scripts/claude-diagnose.sh: runs diagnose.sh bash checks, invokes Claude CLI with Solvr skill context
Add 'diagnose' subcommand to proactive-amcp.sh CLI dispatcher
Read ANTHROPIC_API_KEY and SOLVR_API_KEY from env or ~/.amcp/config.json
Build prompt with health findings + Solvr CLI path, invoke claude --dangerously-skip-permissions --no-session-persistence
Claude searches Solvr for each finding, tries fixes, posts novel issues, returns enriched JSON
Support --bash-only (skip Claude), --no-solvr (skip Solvr), --json (raw output) flags
Verify: proactive-amcp diagnose outputs JSON with solvr_searches and fixes_attempted fields

description: Bundle Solvr skill with proactive-amcp and install during fleet setup
steps: Copy Solvr skill files (SKILL.md, solvr.sh, skill.json, api.md, examples.md) to skills/solvr/
install.sh fetches latest via curl -sL solvr.dev/install.sh | bash, falls back to bundled copy
claude-diagnose.sh prefers installed skill at ~/.claude/skills/solvr/, falls back to bundled
Verify: skills/solvr/scripts/solvr.sh exists and is executable
Verify: install.sh installs Solvr skill to ~/.claude/skills/solvr/

description: Store anthropic.apiKey in proactive-amcp config for diagnose command
steps: config.sh already supports arbitrary dot-paths — no changes needed
openclaw-deploy master-setup.sh stores ANTHROPIC_API_KEY via proactive-amcp config set anthropic.apiKey
claude-diagnose.sh reads ANTHROPIC_API_KEY from env or config.json
Verify: proactive-amcp config get anthropic.apiKey returns stored key

description: Fix full-checkpoint.sh staging to exclude secret-bearing config files — stop copying ~/.amcp/config.json, secrets-full.json, cache, openclaw.json, auth-profiles.json into staging content
steps: Replace rsync of ~/.amcp/ (line 322) with targeted copy: only copy identity.json into $STAGING_DIR/amcp/ (secrets are already handled by --secrets flag to amcp checkpoint create)
Remove cp of ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json into staging (line 327) — secrets are extracted by extract_all_secrets(), raw config should not be in content
Remove cp of ~/.openclaw/auth-profiles.json into staging (line 328) — tokens are extracted by extract_all_secrets()

Add config metadata extraction: write non-secret structural metadata to $STAGING_DIR/openclaw/config-metadata.json using jq or python3 (agent names, skill names, gateway port, channel types — no secret values)
Verify: staging directory contains amcp/identity.json but NOT amcp/config.json, amcp/secrets-full.json, amcp/cache/, openclaw/openclaw.json, or openclaw/auth-profiles.json
Verify: pre-validation (scan_for_secrets) passes without --force on staging directory that previously required --force

description: Add config-metadata.json extraction — capture non-secret config structure for recovery without exposing credentials
steps: Create extract_config_metadata() function in full-checkpoint.sh that reads ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json and outputs redacted structural metadata
Metadata must include: gateway.port, gateway.bind, channels (names + enabled status, NOT tokens), skills.entries (names + enabled status, NOT apiKeys), agents.defaults.workspace path
Metadata must NOT include: any field matching secret patterns (jwt, token, apiKey, password, secret, mnemonic, key), channel botToken values, auth profile credentials
Write output to $STAGING_DIR/openclaw/config-metadata.json
Verify: config-metadata.json passes scan_for_secrets with zero detections
Verify: config-metadata.json contains skill names and gateway port but no secret values

description: Integration tests for staging exclusion fix — full-checkpoint succeeds without --force when config files contain secrets
steps: Test: full-checkpoint.sh with secrets in ~/.amcp/config.json and ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json succeeds without --force (exit 0, no REFUSED message)
Test: full-checkpoint.sh still refuses if workspace content (e.g., workspace/MEMORY.md) contains a hardcoded API key (exit 1, REFUSED message)
Test: staging directory after STAGE 2 contains amcp/identity.json but NOT amcp/config.json or amcp/secrets-full.json
Test: staging directory after STAGE 2 contains openclaw/config-metadata.json but NOT openclaw/openclaw.json or openclaw/auth-profiles.json
Test: config-metadata.json contains gateway port and skill names but zero values matching secret patterns
Test: --force flag still works and produces loud warning when workspace content has secrets
